title: Qualified baselines and continuation policy
summary: Wire UI Swing v0.2-dev11 is the current source-qualified implementation baseline. It preserves the fully qualified dev10 Server v0.17 / Builder v0.11 / RangeRequested / workspace-context semantics and adds renderer-only document row hierarchy plus compact projected lifecycle/status chips. Historical dev3/dev5/dev6 remain provenance/recovery evidence, not the continuation head.
invariants: Continue from packages/wire_ui_swing_v0.2-dev11; do not silently downgrade to roll-up dev3, sealed dev5, reconstructed dev6, or dev10.
Dev11 changes presentation only: projected status may alter pixels, tooltip and accessibility text, but never action feasibility or business state.
Retain dev10 semantic qualification for Server v0.17 flat window metadata, bounded RangeRequested, workspaceContext, real ooRexx/BSF and Builder v0.11 integration.
For any successor, rerun strict Java, renderer regression, executable-JAR and real-window checks; rerun semantic integration whenever protocol/runtime behavior changes.
Keep generic Java/Swing rules in the java sphere; keep Wire-specific renderer/protocol/qualification knowledge in this sphere.
procedure: Start from packages/wire_ui_swing_v0.2-dev11 on animatedads/alchemy main.
Preserve stable semantic identities and the existing event-time UI_ACTION boundary.
Treat material/style-role changes as renderer presentation only.
Run strict Java and the complete renderer suite; capture a real desktop for presentation changes.
If semantic/protocol code changes, rerun Server v0.17, Builder v0.11 and ooRexx/BSF integration before sealing.
Update this sphere and exact continuity records when a successor becomes qualified.
